title: CHEPTA project, format 6
description: A CHEPTA project file of format 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6 (src/ui/project.js). Format 3 adds user_data (proposal 0012); format 4 adds the flowsheet's energy streams, its hx, valve, pump, compressor and expander blocks, and workbench.hx (proposal 0013); format 5 adds workbench.chart, the charts of the Charts workspace (proposal 0013, step 7: kind TS, PH or HS, P_kPa, T_K, compression, points and waterPoints (up to 12 each, two of T_K, P_kPa, h_kJ_kg, s_kJ_kgK, VF), components, z). Format 6 adds the flowsheet's column block (proposal 0015, milestone M1). A project is written in the lowest format that holds it.

workbench.description: Settings and inputs of every workspace (see src/ui/project.js); {} gives the defaults.

results.description: A record of results at save time; never read back into a calculation.

user_data.description: The user's own data (format 3 and later; src/thermo/user-data.js).

components.description: Names, ids, formulas or CAS numbers of CHEPTA.listComponents().

energyStreams.description: Format 4: energy feeds into a heater or flash drum, or the heat of one block into another.

energy.description: Name of the block's energy stream (heater, flash, separator); default Q-<id>. false: the drawing shows no energy stream for the block (its duty is still calculated and counted in the energy balance).

spec.description: feed: flow_kmol_h or flow_kg_h, and two of T_K, P_kPa, VF. mixer: P_kPa (optional). splitter: fractions [one per outlet, one may be "rest"]. separator: fractions { component: [one per outlet] }, outlets [{ T_K, P_kPa } or null]. flash: two of T_K, P_kPa, VF, duty_kW. heater: one of T_K, duty_kW, VF (or T_K and VF), or A_m2 (rating, with its sizing; water or a fluid with flow_kg_h), with P_kPa or dP_kPa; design (optional): the design specification a rated block was rated from. product: none. heater (format 4): sizing { utility: { kind: steam|water|fluid|electric, ... }, U, arrangement } (optional). hx: one of T_hot_out_K, T_cold_out_K, VF_hot_out, VF_cold_out, duty_kW, dTmin_K, A_m2 (rating an exchanger of that area; needs U); dP_hot_kPa, dP_cold_kPa; U and arrangement (optional); ports hot and cold. valve: P_kPa or dP_kPa. pump: P_kPa or dP_kPa, efficiency (0 to 1, default 0.75). compressor and expander: one of P_kPa, dP_kPa, ratio (outlet over inlet), and the isentropic efficiency (0 to 1, default 0.75 and 0.8). Reactors (proposal 0010): see src/units/reactors.js and kinetic-reactors.js. column (format 6; proposal 0015, M1, M2a and M2b): mode ("shortcut" or "rigorous"). Shortcut: light_key, heavy_key, recovery_light_key_in_distillate and recovery_heavy_key_in_bottoms (0 to 1), reflux_ratio or reflux_over_minimum (above 1), condenser ("total" or "partial", default total), P_kPa (default the feed's). Rigorous: stages (3 or more; 1 the condenser, the last the reboiler), feed_stage (a stage from 2 to stages - 1, or a list, one per inlet), condenser, P_kPa, and two of reflux_ratio, boilup_ratio, distillate_kmol_h, bottoms_kmol_h, condenser_duty_kW, reboiler_duty_kW; max_iterations (optional, a limit on the Newton iterations); phases ("VL", the default, or "VLL": look for two liquids on the stages, activity models); condenser "decanter" (phases VLL; one specification, not the reflux ratio or the condenser duty) with reflux_liquid ("light", the default, or "heavy"); method (optional, the column's own property method: { model, vapour, sets, prefer }, as the flowsheet's thermo) (the keys of the other mode are kept and not used); ports in (one or more feeds; the shortcut takes one), distillate and bottoms.

from.description: A heater, flash drum or separator whose heat goes to `to`; leave out for an energy feed.

to.description: A heater or flash drum: its duty comes from the stream. An energy feed placed on the drawing but not connected yet has none (the flowsheet is then not ready).

duty_kW.description: An energy feed's duty (+ heat in); not with `from`.
